description: 한국철도기술연구원 한국철도표준규격 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국철도기술연구원. 철도안전법에 근거하여 국가 차원의 철도 안전관리 체계를 강화하고, 철도 시스템 전반의 안전성 확보와 상호 운용성 증진을 위해 철도차량 및 각종 철도용품에 대한 표준규격을 제정·운영하고. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국철도기술연구원. Its tags are 표준규격, KRS, 규격, 철도, 철도차량. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-03-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
